==Description== Tower Defense Simulator has ambience sounds play in the background in specific parts of the game. These are, most often, long audios that play on loop, similarly to [[Soundtrack]]s, though these are separate and have different purposes. Its volume can be altered in the [[Settings]], though not all are affected. __TOC__ ==Map Ambience==
